title: Daily AI Newsletter Weekly Recap — November 8, 2026
summary: This week, the market and the ballot box turned on AI's spending story together — OpenAI's $30 billion raise closed at $11 billion while voters banned or restricted data centers in more than 20 localities and Anthropic's own IPO ran into investor resistance at $1.5 trillion; Anthropic's SEC filing warning that it may be nearing a dangerous self-improvement threshold turned out, per an independent auditor with privileged access, to likely already be months overdue; two of AI's most visible enterprise customers, Goldman Sachs and Revolut, pulled back from premium coding tools over cost; and labs kept racing each other to buy the version-control and security tooling that agentic coding now depends on.
